workflow.current: Derive reference-faithful editable Figma components and assemble the required screens.
workflow.next: Convert the Figma components into reusable PandaCSS recipes with semantic token bindings.
workflow.later: Systematize across multiple flows and reference apps in a separate workflow.
workflow.priority: Efficient component derivation and effective MVP user experience; missing element references and unresolved component specifications take priority over production completeness.

rules: Each tier may depend only on lower tiers. Components within the same tier must not depend on each other.
Every token value is null until populated from verified evidence or an explicit design decision.
Tier 0 owns literal core values and optional aliases. Higher tiers reference Foundation tokens directly and leave token_value null.
A token uses exactly one of token_value or reference_token when populated. Foundation alias chains must resolve without cycles.
Multiple components bind to the same semantic roles. Do not copy a color hex or spacing literal into each component or recipe.
Token names are candidate placeholders and may be refined during derivation; they do not establish the final cross-flow system.
PNGs are reference evidence. They do not constitute editable components or establish exact typography or motion specifications.
Keep unverified colors, typography, spacing, and motion unresolved instead of silently inventing values.
Use named component variants and inputs/actions to support reuse without copying components for each screen.
The profile and chat libraries have native Figma bindings and an explicit Foundation synchronization exporter; remaining scaffold candidates are unfinished.
Completion gate: run skills/validate_component_tiers.py on this entire folder. Only exit 0 clears the gate; incomplete fields, downstream literals, invalid references, and unvalidated files fail.

token_binding_plan.source_of_truth: The Foundation registry; every downstream value binding references Foundation tokens directly.
token_binding_plan.figma: Profile and chat properties bind to User Connections / Foundations. The local registry supplies values through the explicit synchronization exporter.
token_binding_plan.pandacss: Map core values to Panda tokens and semantic tokens; recipes consume token references.
token_binding_plan.cross_tool_sync: Run figma/export_foundation_sync.py --plan, then emit and apply each --batch in order through use_figma. Variables and recorded vector paths, photo crops and badge positions update on existing nodes. No live watcher or PandaCSS conversion exists yet.
token_binding_plan.expected_result: After those bindings and synchronization are implemented, changing a core value propagates through dependent aliases, recipes, and component instances.
